about: dsl.expand -> plan.to_plan (kdt .25, fc 2) -> plan.frames -> liveliness.animate(seed) -> basis.synthesize (limits + shoulder clearance, no mujoco projection); limited = basis.limit_frames(actuator rows, 1/25 s), the robot's speed caps; see expressive/golden.py

cases.recipe: osc 3 a .5 1.2 E=2 | osc 2 z .4 .9 | osc 2 d .1 1.5 E=.2 | hold 1 E=0
go .3 p=.3 E=1 | osc 2 nod .3 .6 | osc 1.5 sway .3 .9 E=2 | osc 1.2 chatter .3 .4 | go .4 p=0 g=.15

errors.error: unknown channel 'q' (use a x z p k b d g E)
hold only changes energy (E=v); move with go: 'hold 1 p=.3'
osc period below 0.3 s: fast shaking belongs in E (energy), not osc
osc on unknown channel 'E' (use a x z p k b d g or nod bob sway lean turn chatter)
osc on unknown channel 'wiggle' (use a x z p k b d g or nod bob sway lean turn chatter)
osc needs: osc D ch amp period, got 'osc 2 p .3'
osc amplitude 3 too big for p (range -1..1)
osc only changes energy (E=v); move with go: 'osc 2 p .3 1 z=.5'
recipe lasts 31.0 s; keep it under 30 s

presets.name: happy
presets.idea: Throw the arm up and out with the claw open, bounce and sway side to side like a wave, settle bright.

presets.name: sad
presets.prompt: sad. You just heard disappointing news.
presets.idea: Sink at once: the arm sags and the claw hangs, the head drops to the floor, then turn a little away and stay there.

presets.name: curious
presets.prompt: curious. Something new caught your eye.
presets.idea: Reach toward it with the head up, cock the claw one way then the other, inch closer.

presets.name: excited
presets.idea: Snap the arm up with the claw wide open, bounce fast, wiggle the whole body, chatter, then simmer.

presets.name: proud
presets.idea: Rise slowly to a tall open stance with the head held high and the chest pushed toward the person, then hold still.

presets.name: confused
presets.idea: Head up, look one way and then the other with the claw tipping each way, a puzzled pause, look again.

presets.name: surprised
presets.prompt: surprised. That came out of nowhere.
presets.idea: A beat of stillness, then the body jerks back, the arm snaps in, head flies up and the claw gapes; freeze, slowly recover.

presets.name: scared
presets.prompt: scared. Something big is coming at you.
presets.idea: Shrink and get away: the arm pulls in, the head drops, the body backs off and turns aside, trembling.

presets.name: angry
presets.idea: Square up with the head lowered in a glare, then lunge at the person with the claw snapping, twice, and hold the glare.

presets.name: sleepy
presets.idea: Sink heavier and heavier until the head hangs, jerk half awake, then sink for good, turned a little away.

presets.name: agreeing
presets.idea: Lean in and nod with head and arm together, in clear beats, then settle attentive.

presets.name: disagreeing
presets.prompt: shaking your head no. You refuse.
presets.idea: Pull the arm in, then turn the whole body firmly side to side, three times, and stop square.

presets.name: thinking
presets.prompt: thinking. Let me figure this out.
presets.idea: Bring the claw up beside the head and look up and away, roll it slowly while pondering, then come back.

presets.name: affectionate
presets.prompt: affectionate. You are happy to see a friend.
presets.idea: Rise softly toward the friend with the head up and the claw half open, sway the tilted claw, lean closer.

presets.name: bored
presets.idea: Sag with the head down, chew on nothing for a while, then turn away and stay slumped.

presets.name: relieved
presets.idea: Tense and tucked for a moment, then a long exhale: everything loosens, sinks a little and settles calm.

presets.name: listening
presets.prompt: listening. Someone is talking to you.
presets.idea: Turn the attention up to the speaker: a slight lean in, head raised, a small acknowledging nod.
